provenance: Float runtime cases for the loaderless selfhost chain, measured 2026-10-23 on arm64 Linux (podman linux/arm64, no C compiler/loader, no JVM/Node) at amu origin/main 6245712a. Route: seed/CORE-STATIC-MANIFEST compiler core built as the static image C0 by the selfhost S3 (scripts/seed/selfhost-bootstrap.py step 3) compiles each case to an aarch64-macos payload (41-a64gen float codegen), extract-native yields the payload binary, and the C-free runner R-aarch64 (S3-built, seed/x86_64-kx64-runner.kotoba, seed/77-aarch64-static-rt mode 1) executes it (KEXE_COMMAND=1 KEXE_STRUCTURED_REPORT=1 KEXE_FUEL=1000000 KEXE_ALLOW=-). The same sources are refused on the x86_64-linux selfhost S-route at SIR admission (xg-check-sir in seed/70-x86_64-linux.kotoba: OP-BIN outside 1..10, OP-CMP outside 1..5, OP-UN outside UOP-NOT/UOP-BITNOT -> E7101), so the S-route cannot run them; the refusal is asserted by scripts/seed/selfhost-float-cases.py as the measured boundary. Each case records refusalDetail: the E7101 detail xg-check-sir emits (the first float SIR opcode the admission sees; 33 = f64-domain, 36 = f32-domain ops on this route), asserted in addition to the error code so an earlier unrelated refusal cannot masquerade as this boundary. The f32 CMP and f32 UN cases were added 2026-10-23 from PR #1501 review (gn-fl-cmp-emit / gn-fl-un single-precision branches) and measured on the same producers: refusal detail 36, references {exit 0, remainingFuel 1000000}, results 42 / 4. Float ops carry no fuel charge (remaining == initial). All results are IEEE-754 semantics.
